verdict.rationale: Jina Reader's core purpose is converting messy URLs/HTML into clean, LLM-ready Markdown text, handling anti-bot/proxy challenges, JS rendering, PDFs, Office docs, and images automatically so users don't need to build scraping/rendering infrastructure themselves. This is well-documented across multiple output-format controls (frontmatter, chunking, JSON schema extraction) and anti-blocking features (proxy rotation, cookie forwarding, engine selection).
